---
pagetitle: "Peekbank | Datasets"
title: "Datasets"
---

All datasets in the current Peekbank release. Each dataset was contributed by
the original research team and imported into the common Peekbank format; see
the [How to Cite](https://peekbank.github.io/peekbank-website/misc/howtocite/)
page for citation policy — when you use a dataset, cite its original
publication (shown here) as well as the database.

```{ojs manifest-data}
//| output: false
manifest = d3.json("slices/manifest.json")
```

```{ojs datasets-table}
Inputs.table(
  manifest.datasets.map((d) => ({
    dataset: d.name,
    citation: d.cite || d.shortcite,
    children: d.n_subjects,
    sessions: d.n_admins,
    trials: d.n_trials,
    "age range (mo)": `${d.age_min}–${d.age_max}`,
    method: d.methods.join(", "),
    languages: d.languages.join(", "),
    words: d.n_words,
  })),
  { maxHeight: 700, layout: "auto" }
)
```

```{ojs release-note}
html`<p style="color:#6b7280">Release ${manifest.version} ·
${manifest.datasets.length} datasets · generated from the
<a href="https://redivis.com/datapages/datasets/peekbank">peekbank dataset on
Redivis</a>.</p>`
```
